title: French Lamb Stew with Berbere
description: A rich and flavorful French-inspired stew made with lamb, berbere spice, and hearty vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown lamb cubes in batches until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove lamb from pot and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then sauté onions and garlic until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add carrots and potatoes, cook for 5 minutes.
Add berbere spice, red wine, and beef broth, scraping up browned bits.
Return lamb to pot, bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2.5 hours, or until lamb is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
